column1: # The ways PoDoFo's tests open the encrypted PDFs of podofo-resources, one
# line for each way of opening one file, read from the test sources named
# above each group. fetch-corpus.ps1 writes these lines to _passwords.tsv with
# the suite's name in front of each file.
# A line gives a password the test source holds that PDFBox opens the file
# with, and an empty one besides where the file also opens with none. Thirteen
# of the documents under TechDocs/ name an encryption dictionary too; they
# open with no password, and no test opens them with one, so no line names
# "userpass"; the source's other password, "ownerpass", does not open them
# "userpass"; both open with no password as well
